name: Discretion
definition: Indicates on an order that the trader wishes to display one price in the market but will accept trades at another price.

Offset.name: Offset
Offset.definition: Amount added to the 'related to' price.

OffsetSign.name: Offset Sign
OffsetSign.definition: Indicates whether the offset should be added or subtracted from the related price.

RelatedPriceType.name: Related Price Type
RelatedPriceType.definition: Identify the type of price an offset is related to. The offset can either be added or subtracted.

MoveType.name: Move Type
MoveType.definition: Describes whether discretion price is static/fixed or floats.

LimitType.name: Limit Type
LimitType.definition: Specifies the nature of the resulting discretion price (e.g. or better limit, strict limit etc).

RoundDirection.name: Round Direction
RoundDirection.definition: If the calculated discretion price is not a valid tick price, specifies how to round the price (e.g. to be more or less aggressive)

Scope.name: Scope
Scope.definition: The scope of "related to" price of the discretion (e.g. local, global etc)

OffsetType.name: Offset Type
OffsetType.definition: Describes the type of Discretion Offset .

RelatedOrderExecution.name: Related Order Execution
RelatedOrderExecution.definition: Order instruction for which a discretion is specified.
